days.lab_task: Implement a command-line payroll calculator with an Employee value object. Parse employee ID, hours and rate; calculate gross pay; reject blank IDs, negative hours and negative rates.
days.deliverable: Java source, test cases and a sample payroll report
days.assessment:
Employee E01, 40 hours and rate 25.50 produces gross pay 1020.00
A blank ID or negative hours is rejected without producing a payroll row
Three valid employees retain their original IDs and report total gross pay equal to the sum of individual pays
learning_objectives: Calculate gross pay for valid decimal inputs
Separate parsing errors from business-rule errors
days.scenario: A payroll utility must parse employee hours and rates without accepting invalid or missing values.
preparation_requirements: Prepare the stated lab fixture or training environment

Verify expected results: Employee E01, 40 hours and rate 25.50 produces gross pay 1020.00; A blank ID or negative hours is rejected without producing a payroll row; Three valid employees retain their original IDs and report total gross pay equal to the sum of individual pays

delivery_steps.evidence: Baseline example and first expected result
